lines.zh: 我从天花板上挪动半格。
lines.en: I shift half a block along the ceiling.
One turn of the winch and I slide across.
The chain rings in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在下面的石头上。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the stone below.

lines.zh: 我挂在磁场洞穴的顶上。
lines.en: I hang from the ceiling of the magnetic cave.
I slide half a block along the iron beam.
I move another block.
The chain on me swings as I go.
I travel along an iron beam.
I'm looking for something below.
I stop, and the chain keeps swinging.
I move further into the cave.
Rust falls from the hook.
The hammer hangs beneath me.
I hear someone walking in the cave.
The field makes the dust float.
My winch caught for a moment.
I wait for a target to pass beneath.
A little rust flakes off the chain.

lines.zh: 我身上没有脸，也没有嘴。
lines.en: I have no face and no mouth.
It pulls me perfectly straight.
The ceiling is far above the floor.

lines.zh: 天花板上的矿脉在我眼里。
lines.en: The ore veins in the ceiling are in my view.
Only the chain knocks now and then.
I count the footsteps below.
A red glow wavers on the hammer face.
The magnetic field holds me while dust swirls.

lines.zh: 我在上面等着，一动不动。
lines.en: I wait up here without moving.
Wind rises from below.
I've hung here I don't know how long.
You looked up, right below me.
I'm directly above you.

lines.zh: 你踩在锁扣投下的影子里。
lines.en: You stand in the shadow the catch casts.
I hang from the ceiling, hammer down.
One more step and the chain will reach.
I'm slowly lowering.
You can't see me, can you?

lines.zh: 链子的声音你听见了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the chain?
I drop on three.
There's a shadow over your head.

lines.zh: 我的锤子已经松开了卡扣。
lines.en: My hammer has slipped its catch.

lines.zh: 抬头你会看见锈和红光。
lines.en: Look up and you will see rust and red light.
My chain is swinging hard.

lines.zh: 锤子扫过洞顶的钟乳石。
lines.en: My hammer sweeps past a stalactite.
The winch clicked.
I've winched up a little.
The chain rattles in a long shiver.
That struck askew.
I hang there, swaying a long time.
I steady the chain.
The chain goes taut; I do not fall.

lines.zh: 钩子蹭着石顶，慢慢停住。
lines.en: The hook scrapes the ceiling and slowly stops.
I only care where you stand.
I hang from the ceiling, waiting.

lines.zh: 动的东西下面，就是落点。
lines.en: Whatever moves marks the landing spot.
I'm only looking for a place to drop.
Bait cannot stop a falling hammer.
I shift one block toward it.
I can reach that now.
That's a good position.

lines.zh: 吊在洞顶的重锤，不用诱饵。
lines.en: A hammer on the cave ceiling needs no bait.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，重锤就落。
lines.en: Set it down and the hammer falls.

lines.zh: 你撞在我垂下的链子上。
lines.en: You hit my hanging chain.
The chain is swinging hard.
I've been knocked down a little.
You being below is good.
My hammer grazed your head.
That was only chance.
I've winched back up.
You've stepped out of my drop point.
The winch is knocked half a block off.
I need to move.
I'm the only one in this cave.
These machines are built.
Another hangs nearby.
It's as quiet as I am.
Our chains touch.
Our chains ring separately.
We each hang in place.
We watch the same path.
Whoever drops first gets it.

lines.zh: 之后我们守着各自的位置。
lines.en: Afterward we keep our own positions.
I winch it up.
The chain tightens and it comes up.
I've wedged it in the winch.
Too heavy; I can't hold it.
I lower it back.
There's nowhere to put it up here.
I drop it again.
Metal on metal rings out.
It keeps swinging on the chain.
It's no use to me.
You're walking below.
I've let the winch out a little.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声落在锤子的正下方。
lines.en: Your footsteps land directly under my hammer.

lines.zh: 链节一节节从我手里滑。
lines.en: Chain links slide through my grip one by one.

lines.zh: 绞盘咬住了最后一节链。
lines.en: The winch bites on the last link.
You didn't hear the chain.

lines.zh: 锤底离你的头顶只剩半臂。
lines.en: My hammer hangs half an arm above your head.
The hammer is aimed at you.
I'm in no hurry.
You're standing right under the latch.
I move along the ceiling.

lines.zh: 你走过的路上有我影子。
lines.en: My shadow is on the path you took.
I shift to another beam.
Higher up is steadier.
Your position has shifted.
I'm lined up again.
The chain keeps ringing.
I don't look at anything else.
You've started to run, and I follow.
I can keep pace with you from up here.
The hammer falls onto your shoulder.
You're driven half to your knees.
A split opens in the floor.
The chain whips your arm.
I haul the hammer back up.
That one missed by two fingers.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，锤子下来了。
lines.en: You backed to the wall. Here comes the hammer.

lines.zh: 我吊在天花板上垂着锤。
lines.en: I hang from the ceiling with my hammer.
Gravel still clings to the hammer's face.
My winch is sticking.

lines.zh: 我从上方的锁扣上垂下来。
lines.en: I hang down from the latch above.
The chain unfolds link by link.
The field passes over me.
First I test the hammer.

lines.zh: 锁扣咬进石顶，我垂下来。
lines.en: The catch bites into the ceiling and I hang down.
I hang in midair.
I hear footsteps in the cave.

lines.zh: 我的红光在黑暗里很显眼。
lines.en: My red light shows in the dark.

lines.zh: 我用绞盘吊着，用重锤砸。
lines.en: A winch holds me; a hammer drops.
The hammer sways once.
I've dropped half a block.

lines.zh: 下面的影子落进了我的范围。
lines.en: A shadow below has entered my reach.

lines.zh: 火燎到链条，我上面的绞盘发烫。
lines.en: Fire scorches the chain and my winch grows hot.

lines.zh: 我从钩子上脱落，摔在石头上。
lines.en: I slip the hook and crash onto the stone.

lines.zh: 水淹到洞里，我的齿轮在响。
lines.en: Water reaches the cave and my gears grind.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从梁上震下来。
lines.en: The blast shakes me off the beam.

lines.zh: 箭打在我的壳上，弹开了。
lines.en: An arrow hits my casing and glances off.

lines.zh: 那股力让我的磁力乱了。
lines.en: That force scrambles my magnet.
Hunger is not something I have.

lines.zh: 电流顺着链条上来，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Current runs up the chain and I jolt.

lines.zh: 钩子空了，我一路往下坠。
lines.en: The hook holds nothing and I fall.
